name: Jiangsu Lihua Foods Group Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Lihua Foods Group Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in livestock and poultry breeding in China. It operates through Chicken, Pigs, Goose, and Others segments. The company breeds, slaughters, and sells commercial yellow-feathered broiler chickens; and breeds and sells commercial pigs and geese. It also provides fresh and frozen yellow-feathered broiler chicken products; eggs; and seedlings. In addition, the company engages in investment activities; slaughtering and meat processing; grain trading; livestock and poultry research; and agricultural product testing activities.
